chapter: Learning drums and recording on the Coast
title: Julia Lee and Lovett play the Apollo in New York
summary: Goodwin recalls agents wanting Julia to stay; Lovett says the two played a week at the Apollo.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: I think I remember some of it where-- I don't remember exactly what time this was but Julia and yourself were out. Was this in Washington, D. C. or was it in Los Angeles where they tried to get Julia to stay and they had -- there were several agents come up to her with different bookings where she could have worked and you two could have stayed out that way indefinitely.
Did you and Julia go to New York. I didn't know that.
Where did you play in New York?
Yeah, we played up there. We played there and --
When you say we who was with you and Julia?
Just the two of us, yeah. We were there -- we done a week there, she and I. They sent for us.
You were here and they booked you from here.
